pyqgis_plugin.name: Urban Heat Island (Landsat 10/11)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Map urban heat islands from Landsat 8/9 thermal bands 10 and 11
pyqgis_plugin.about: Enter a date, location name, latitude/longitude and radius. The plugin finds the least-cloudy Landsat 8/9 scene within +/-7 days, reads bands 10 and 11 from the first working source (local folder, AWS S3, or USGS HTTPS), computes land surface temperature with a split-window algorithm in memory-bounded blocks, and adds styled LST and UHI class layers without freezing QGIS. See the README for data-access requirements.
